statement: Endpoint Sobolev regularity of centered disk averages. Resolves the planar centered-disk case of the Hajłasz–Onninen maximal-function regularity problem. For every real $`f\in W^{1,1}(\mathbb R^2)`$, the centered disk maximal function satisfies $`\|\nabla Mf\|_1\le C\|\nabla f\|_1`$ with an absolute constant. It belongs locally to $`W^{1,1}`$ and has a globally integrable weak gradient.
